releases.notes:
For **Minecraft 1.21.11** with Fabric.

**[Download the mod (.jar)](https://github.com/Jlorenzoo/complex-skyblock-tools/releases/download/v1.1.0-mc1.21.11/skyblock-toolkit-1.1.0%2Bmc1.21.11.jar)**

1. Close Minecraft.
2. Put the downloaded jar in your **mods** folder. Remove any older Skyblock Toolkit jar.
3. Start Minecraft and press **Right Shift** to open the menu.

Needs **Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer**, **Fabric API for 1.21.11** and **Java 21**.

[Source code](https://github.com/Jlorenzoo/complex-skyblock-tools/tree/v1.1.0-mc1.21.11)
